# Label dependency of reported figures

**All figures here are conditional all-live benchmark counts or estimates. None is a production full-gate precision/recall measurement.** The grouping uses the fixed v1 folded-name/identity equality rule and no invented financial state. Ordering is the historical slot/signature benchmark order, not a measured within-slot transaction order.

| figure | conditional benchmark value | assistant labels required? |
|---|---|---|
| launches / routes / new rooms | 2956 / 1732 / 1224 | no; metadata-only grouping under the all-live assumption |
| semantic precision / recall estimate | 99.83% / 87.37% | yes; same legacy estimator and assistant labels as text_calibration.md |
| nonempty identical-URI copy cohort | 1027 | no; exact string-duplication definition |
| identical URI to room root | 768/1027 (74.78%) | no; strict URI-group root recovery, not general semantic recall |
| identical URI in an earlier face of selected room | 1025/1027 (99.81%) | no; group containment, not proof that the root is the right narrative |
| root identity-or-URI definition matches in that cohort | 972/1027 (94.64%) | no human judgement; depends on the published folding/identity policy |
| routed URI-cohort cases requiring semantic judgement against the root | 53 | yes: 35 S, 1 D, 0 U, 17 unlabelled |

**Correction to the old identical-URI recall claim:** its denominator was selected without labels, but its numerator scored correctness against the root with the same label/stratum estimator as other routes. It was not wholly label-independent. The strict URI metrics above avoid that estimator and name exactly what they count.

The archived text benchmark also groups empty URI strings together: 8 launches have no URI, contributing 7 extra cases to its legacy URI-copy denominator of 1034. Missing URI is not evidence of copied metadata. The independent nonempty-URI metrics exclude those cases; historical benchmark outputs are retained with their original definition for comparison.

Even a repeated nonempty mutable HTTP URI proves string equality, not identical historical JSON/image bytes. Folded identity is also a definition, not independent human confirmation of narrative meaning. All semantic S/D/U labels are assistant judgements without human review. Their stratum estimates, pessimistic estimates and expected-vamp denominator depend on those judgements. Raw age/slot counts and fixed-target gate bounds do not use narrative labels, but retain their disclosed cohort/proxy assumptions.
